_about: Parts of the frozen engine that no package manager knows about: the Python
runtime and the native libraries PyInstaller copies next to it from the
build machine. scripts/third-party-notices.py matches every such file in
the build against 'files' (file-name patterns) and fails on a file that
matches nothing here, so a new native library cannot ship unnoticed. The
licence is checked against allowed.txt like any other. Several patterns
cover one platform only; entries whose files are not in a build are left
